mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 3.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns on the joint growth of HOUST and RSAFS, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO below 12-month moving average), a monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving supply conditions, reducing the risk of supply shocks and predicting positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 12-month MA and rises in the subsequent month, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises above 3.5% YoY, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods with rising PAYEMS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic expansion, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the joint growth of GDPC1 and HOUST, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
